verdict.rationale: Token2 documents real Entra ID integration: a bulk-enrollment tool that registers FIDO2 keys through the Graph Provisioning API (with random PINs and result logging), a PowerShell/Graph registration guide, Entra hardware-token OTP import files, and Intune workstation passwordless setup. Okta and Google Workspace are not covered, and nothing shows enforcing hardware-key-only policies. Missing for 10: Okta integration, Google Workspace integration, documented policy enforcement requiring hardware-key authentication, independent corroboration.
